api.notes: A number attribute for fixed columns. The upstream object form {minWidth, max, repeat} is the same property (`columns`) and the attribute trio column-min-width / column-max / column-repeat (never a JSON attribute).
Number is px, string a CSS length; not reflected. Sizes the host.
Sizes the host, so a percentage resolves against the parent.

api.reason: A-xstyle: use the host, `::part(base)` (also for `grid-template-columns` inside media or container queries), or the documented attributes or the documented attributes.
The element itself is the handle; the box is reachable as part "base".

differences.text: `align` is the `alignment` attribute (A§7.2). The responsive `columns` object is also written as the attributes `column-min-width`, `column-max` and `column-repeat`, because config objects are never JSON attributes; the object form stays available as the `columns` property and wins over the attributes.
The host carries the sizes; an inner part="base" grid container carries the tracks, gaps and padding. Grid also accepts the padding attributes of BoxPropsMixin (upstream Grid has none).

The track template is set through the private --_columns custom property computed in the class and consumed by the stylesheet, so a consumer rule on ::part(base) (also inside @media or @container) can override it, as upstream's CSS-variable indirection allows for xstyle.

core.grid.notes: Guides: [mwg:css-layout] grid, repeat(auto-fill, minmax()), logical properties; [mwg:styling-web-components] host rules, part=base, custom-property inheritance; [mwg:shadow-dom] slot inside the grid container. Size budget 13 kB (above the S default of 12): Grid plus GridSpan (per-instance adopted sheet for spans beyond 12) on top of lit (12.5 kB gzip measured).

differences.text: The host is the grid item (display: grid, min-inline-size 0, block-size 100%), so styles on <tct-grid-span> (margin, grid placement) reach the item directly; upstream renders a div with those styles.

core.grid-span.notes: Guides: [mwg:css-layout] `grid-column: span n`, `min-inline-size: 0` on grid items; [mwg:custom-elements] reflected converters for `columns`. Size budget 13 kB (above the S default of 12): Grid plus GridSpan (per-instance adopted sheet for spans beyond 12) on top of lit (12.5 kB gzip measured).
